text:
Mira (Marketing): Quick sync 10:00am PT publish target for the release post + changelog tomorrow. Need final docs permalink, a short bench stat, and webinar/reg link by EOD.

Tom (Eng): ACK. Can we freeze canary at 8:30am PT so rollout doesn't overlap publish? There's a tiny batching-edge behavior I'll add to the migration guide (non-breaking).

Asha (Product): No breaking API changes. Main visible win: smarter routing for short-session chat -> p95 improvement. I'll draft the single-sentence product blurb.

Ruth (Docs): Draft changelog preview is live: https://redwood.inference/docs/changelog/v8-preview. Will add migration note once Tom posts wording.

Diego (Release): We need a permalink by 6pm PT for the static-site pipeline. If deploy is green, plan to merge blog at 9:25am PT for a final QA pass before 10:00 publish.

Lin (Design): Design needs the benchmark PNG by 5:00pm PT for social assets. Where will Tom upload?

Tom (Eng): I'll export the micro-bench PNG and put it in /drive/marketing/assets by 4:30pm PT. Caption: "internal benchmark 1 95th percentile latency 1 short sessions."

Mira (Marketing): Bench copy check: can we say "up to 32% lower p95 for short-chat workloads"?

Tom (Eng): 32% is near-lab max for tiny samples (<40 tokens). Recommend conservative phrasing: "up to ~30%" across our test suite.

Asha (Product): +1 to ~30%. Proposed marketing line: "up to ~30% lower p95 latency on short-chat workloads (internal benchmark)."

Ruth (Docs): Changelog snippet (draft):
```
## v8.0 1 Routing and cache improvements (2026-09-14)
- Adaptive routing for short-session traffic
- KV prefix cache tweaks to reduce redundant compute
- Bugfix: stable quantization fallback for mixed-precision paths
```

Mira (Marketing): Perfect. Please post the final permalink here after deploy so I can add it to the blog + social thread.

deploy-bot: scheduled_deploy: docs-site job 22044 1 ETA ~12m

Diego (Release): I'll watch the deploy. If green we'll merge at 9:25am PT for Marketing QA.

Tom (Eng): Uploaded bench PNG to /drive/marketing/assets/v8-bench.png at 16:18 PT.

Ruth (Docs): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912 1 includes migration note and prelink.

deploy-bot: docs-site job 22044 1 SUCCESS. Changelog live: https://redwood.inference/docs/changelog/v8.0

Mira (Marketing): Permalink received, queued blog for 9:25am PT merge and 10:00am publish. Social assets scheduled for 10:10am post-publish. :rocket:

Lin (Design): Copy noted. I'll schedule the social images + alt text.

Tom (Eng): I'll co-present the micro-bench in the 11:00am PT webinar (10-min demo slot). Ping me on the webinar channel if live questions come in.

Diego (Release): All green from release side. Good luck tomorrow everyone.

Mira (Marketing): Thanks team  final checklist looks good :tada:
